summary: C6 scrubbed the carry's composed gates, but any lane phase that runs go test (TDD, build self-checks) still inherits the lane's EVOLVE_WORKTREE_ROOT: TestFlagsGenerateThenCheck_RoundTrip / TestFlagsCheck_DriftExitsTwo resolve their root through sourceRoot(), which prefers it (so generate can write docs/architecture/control-flags.md into the lane worktree), and TestPredicateEnv_AllBranches builds its env from os.Environ().
